fields.counterexample: n/a (no fixed proposition survives outside the trivial case to counterexample; see 'locates' for the constructive finding in its place)
fields.locates: Under the no-shared-structure reading of 'each coordinate Weil-lifted independently' (R1), the lifted vector field fails to type-check for any coordinate-coupled system: e.g. dx/dt=y, dy/dt=-x with X=x+e1*v1 in A1=R[e1]/(e1^2), Y=y+e2*v2 in A2=R[e2]/(e2^2) gives f_1(X,Y)=y+e2*v2, which is not an element of A1 -- no map A2->A1 is supplied. Under the shared-ambient reading (R2), embedding A1,A2 into a common Weil algebra Lambda (e.g. exterior algebra on e1,e2) restores well-typedness but consistency of the ODE forces X to acquire an e2-component (and Y an e1-component) under the flow, i.e. the dynamics collapse the per-coordinate assignment back into one shared global Weil algebra -- exactly the construction the claim proposes to surpass. On the one class where (R1) is well-defined without patching -- diagonal/decoupled systems f_i=f_i(x_i) -- the per-coordinate lift is termwise identical (up to renaming e_i vs shared e) to the ordinary single global Weil algebra construction, so it adds no content. The minimal condition that would exclude this finding: an explicit, canonically-chosen gluing/ambient structure relating A_i to A_j whenever the Jacobian entry df_i/dx_j is nonzero, specified as part of the hypotheses rather than left implicit in the phrase 'fibered'; also noted (Sec 5c) that even a fixed ambient algebra is not unique among same-dimension choices, giving inequivalent transported dynamics for the same system and data.
fields.scope: n=1 (trivial); n=2 diagonal linear system (by hand, first-order dual-number algebras); n=2 coupled linear system (harmonic oscillator dx/dt=y, dy/dt=-x) under both readings (R1) no-shared-structure and (R2) shared ambient algebra, plus one alternative ambient algebra choice illustrating non-canonicity. Not covered: n>=3, nonlinear coupling, higher-order or mixed-order per-coordinate Weil algebras, nested extensions, parameter/time/initial-value extensions -- left open. No CAS available in sandbox (sympy not installed, no PyPI network access); all computations are elementary first-order Taylor/linear substitutions verified by hand.
